executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 90 errors across multiple test classes. The primary issues are: (1) Type incompatibility where TaskStatus and TaskPriority enums cannot be converted to String, (2) Missing setter/getter methods in DTO classes (TaskResponse, PagedTaskResponse, BulkTaskResponse), (3) Method signature mismatches in TaskService interface, and (4) ErrorResponse type conflicts between packages. These errors indicate a mismatch between test code expectations and actual DTO/service implementations.

errors.message: TaskStatus and TaskPriority enums cannot be converted to String (40+ occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Test code is attempting to pass TaskStatus and TaskPriority enum values where String parameters are expected. The DTO setters likely expect String type but tests are passing enum instances directly.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskRequest/TaskResponse DTOs to accept enum types (TaskStatus, TaskPriority) instead of String, or modify test code to call .name() or .toString() on enum values before passing them to setters.

errors.root_cause: TaskResponse DTO does not have a setVersion() method, but test code attempts to call it.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setVersion(long version) method to TaskResponse DTO class, or remove the setVersion() call from tests if version tracking is not required.

errors.message: PagedTaskResponse missing setPage(), setLast(), getPage(), getLast() methods (6 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: PagedTaskResponse DTO does not expose pagination metadata methods that tests expect to use for assertions.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setPage(int), setLast(boolean), getPage(), and getLast() methods to PagedTaskResponse DTO to support pagination metadata access in tests.

errors.message: Method getUserTasks signature mismatch: required (Long, Pageable) but found (Long, int, int, String)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature expects (Long userId, Pageable pageable) but tests are calling it with (Long, int, int, String) parameters for page, size, and sort.
errors.fix_recommendation: Refactor TaskService.getUserTasks() to accept individual pagination parameters (int page, int size, String sort) instead of Pageable, or update test code to construct Pageable objects using PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sort)).

errors.message: BulkTaskResponse missing setSuccessCount(), setFailureCount(), setErrors(), getSuccessCount(), getFailureCount(), getErrors() and inner class BulkTaskError
errors.root_cause: BulkTaskResponse DTO does not have methods to manage bulk operation results (success/failure counts and error details), and the nested BulkTaskError class is missing.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setSuccessCount(int), setFailureCount(int), setErrors(List<BulkTaskError>), getSuccessCount(), getFailureCount(), getErrors() methods to BulkTaskResponse. Create BulkTaskError as a nested static class or separate class with taskId and error message fields.

errors.message: ErrorResponse type mismatch: cannot convert com.myproject.exceptions.ErrorResponse to com.myproject.models.dtos.ErrorResponse (12 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Two ErrorResponse classes exist in different packages (exceptions vs models.dtos). GlobalExceptionHandler returns exceptions.ErrorResponse but tests expect models.dtos.ErrorResponse.
errors.fix_recommendation: Consolidate ErrorResponse into a single class in com.myproject.models.dtos package and update GlobalExceptionHandler to use that class. Remove duplicate ErrorResponse from exceptions package.

errors.message: Cannot find methods: handleConcurrentCreation() and handlePerformanceThreshold()
errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler does not have exception handler methods for ConcurrentTaskCreationException and PerformanceThresholdExceededException.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @ExceptionHandler methods in GlobalExceptionHandler: handleConcurrentCreation(ConcurrentTaskCreationException) and handlePerformanceThreshold(PerformanceThresholdExceededException) to handle these custom exceptions.

summary: 7 grouped compilation error categories found affecting 90+ individual error instances
